title: 4.01 / Spectrum Stores
slide_intent: Scale a message to available space while preserving the central offer so a reader understands the same brand at different lengths.
strategic_value: Approved short and long descriptions can help mall partners describe Spectrum consistently.
demonstration: Three ruled rows pair brief, medium and long descriptions with word limits of 20, 50 and 100.
practical_value: Choose a description length for the placement without treating historical service claims as current facts.

content_islands.name: Heading and guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the title left and the consistency explanation above the table.

content_islands.name: Description ladder
content_islands.spec: Stack three description rows with cyan labels and word limits on the left, and increasingly detailed copy on the right.

ingredient.name: Store description
ingredient.role: Provide a consistent summary at different lengths.
ingredient.application: Select the brief, medium or long approved description with limits of 20, 50 or 100 words respectively.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2017 retail copy. Product claims and customer counts require fresh verification for present use.
